recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, chaotic urban scene viewed through a large window, with a central figure seated on a vintage sofa in the foreground. The background depicts a night riot or protest with a helicopter, luxury car, and burning buildings, while the window itself is defaced with painted text and cracks. The foreground is dimly lit, contrasting with the bright, fiery chaos behind the window.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure on the sofa is positioned as an observer of the chaos unfolding outside the window.
The painted text on the window acts as a barrier and a commentary on the background scene.
The contrast between the calm, dark foreground and the bright, chaotic background creates a sense of tension.
The elements of luxury (car, jewelry, money) are juxtaposed with the destruction and unrest.
coreInvariants: A male figure seated on a sofa in the foreground, facing forward.
A large window behind the figure, showing an urban riot/protest scene.
Text painted on the window, appearing as if written with blood or red paint.
A snake on the sofa next to the figure.
Stacks of money on the sofa next to the figure.
A television set displaying news footage in the foreground.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main subject (man on sofa) occupies the lower-middle portion of the frame, scaled to be prominent but allowing the background scene to be fully visible. He is centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man on the sofa serves as the primary visual anchor, drawing the eye first due to his central placement and relative stillness amidst the chaos.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn from the central figure to the painted text on the window, then outward to the chaotic background scene, following the bright lights and fiery elements. The helicopter and car also guide the eye horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, as the scene is densely packed with visual information. The dark, shadowed areas around the sofa provide some breathing room, contrasting with the busy background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark, desaturated blues, greens, and browns create a somber, gritty mood in the foreground and overall scene.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright oranges and reds from the fires and painted text provide high contrast, signifying danger, urgency, and destruction.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and yellow from flashlights, headlights, and jewelry add points of visual interest and emphasize specific details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The foreground is low saturation and dark value, while the background features higher saturation in the reds/oranges and varying values due to light sources and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid overly bright or pastel colors, except for specific accent elements.
Maintain a predominantly dark and desaturated base palette.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The main title uses a sans-serif, all-caps base skeleton with irregular, hand-painted strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Strokes are thick and uneven, resembling brushstrokes or paint applied roughly.
Letters exhibit a dripping effect, as if paint is running down the surface.
Overall form is slightly condensed but with variable width per character.
Baseline is generally consistent but with minor irregularities.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in 'ALL' has a slightly pointed apex and a wide stance.
The 'S' characters are particularly elongated and fluid.
The 'H' in 'SHIEST' has a slightly wider stance than other letters.

composition.overlap: appears to be painted directly on the glass, overlapping background elements
composition.relationshipToImage: integral to the scene, acting as a visual filter and commentary

treatment.fill: solid red, with darker red/brown drips
treatment.shadow: subtle, suggesting depth on the glass surface
treatment.depth: appears to be on the immediate foreground plane (the window)

composition.relationshipToImage: part of the TV screen content
overlayed on the image, standard label placement

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting a custom, expressive display type with clean, functional sans-serifs for supporting information.
graphicDevices: Dripping paint effect on the main title.
Cracked glass effect on the window.

preserve: The hand-painted, dripping aesthetic of the main title.
The all-caps presentation for all text roles.
The clean, legible nature of the supporting sans-serifs.
avoid: Fonts that do not convey a raw or gritty feel for the main title.

candidateDirections.reason: To emulate the hand-painted, irregular strokes and dripping effect.
To capture the rough, imperfect nature of the letters while maintaining legibility.
To convey an urban, rebellious, and raw aesthetic similar to the painted text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate the full image including the man on the sofa, the urban riot scene through the window, the snake, money, and television screens. Ensure the window has a cracked effect. Leave the area where the main title will go clear, but imply it's a glass surface.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title text 'ALL EYES ON SHIEST' as custom red, dripping, hand-painted lettering on the window. Add the small white 'FREE SHIESTY' text on the shirt of a person in the crowd. Add the white text 'FOX 15 ALL EYES ON SHIEST' on the TV screens. Finally, overlay the 'PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT' label in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text clearly hand-painted and dripping?
Are the supporting texts legible and in a clean sans-serif style?
Is the overall mood gritty and chaotic?
Does the main figure appear calm amidst the background chaos?
Are the elements of luxury (jewelry, money, car) present?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the background chaos (fires, crowd density).
Specific details of the urban environment (buildings, vehicles).
Lighting and color temperature of the foreground vs. background.
Amount and placement of money and snake on the sofa.
Specific wording and placement of supporting text elements (e.g., 'FREE SHIESTY').
mustRedesign: The specific wording of the main title and any brand logos.

mustAchieve: A strong contrast between a calm foreground and a chaotic background.
A dark, gritty, and urban atmosphere.
The appearance of text painted directly onto a glass surface with a dripping effect.
A sense of observation or detachment from the central figure.
avoid: A clean, pristine, or overly polished aesthetic.
Any elements that detract from the urban, rebellious theme.

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the main title's dripping effect is convincing and visually impactful.
Verify that the background elements (fire, crowd, helicopter) convey chaos without being overly cartoonish.
Check that the central figure's posture and expression align with a sense of calm observation.
Confirm that the overall color grading supports the dark, gritty mood.
Ensure all text elements are present and correctly positioned according to their roles.
Verify the cracked glass effect is visible and realistic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a scene with a central figure in a dark, calm interior, observing a chaotic, brightly lit urban exterior through a large, defaced window. Overlay custom, expressive text on the window and functional sans-serif text for supporting details.
